name: llm-prefill-decode-visualizer
description: LLM inference performance math: TTFT, TPOT, walltime for single-turn chat, agentic loops, batched serving, speculative decoding, and KV-cache VRAM. Includes community-measured hardware benchmarks.
docs: /llms.txt — also see /api/agent/capabilities.json for the machine-readable surface list

endpoints.description: Agent-friendly wrapper around the raw community run search (same data as the MCP search_runs tool and /api/localmaxxing). Flat per-run records with freshness stamps, echoed filters, cursor pagination. Filters mirror search_runs: ?hardware=, ?model=, ?quant= plus ?context_band=, ?max_age=, ?limit=, ?cursor=, ?snapshot=.
endpoints.returns: { description, endpoint, snapshot, generatedAt, filters, total, count, runs[], has_more, next_cursor, caveats, relatedEndpoints, schema_version }

endpoints.description: Machine-readable discovery document listing every agent-facing surface of the app with methods, kind and descriptions. Static; CDN-cached 1h.

Agent-friendly wrapper over the same inference math as /api/compute. GET with ?model= plus parameters, or POST {"batch":[...]} up to 50 sets. Flat self-describing envelope with resolved inputs and a deterministic calc id; bare call returns the capability catalog.
endpoints.returns: { description, endpoint, generatedAt, inputs, id, ...mathFields, warnings[], schema_version }

endpoints.description: Agent-friendly wrapper over the same inference math as /api/compute. GET with ?model= plus parameters, or POST {"batch":[...]} up to 50 sets. Flat self-describing envelope with resolved inputs and a deterministic calc id; bare call returns the capability catalog.
endpoints.returns: { description, endpoint, generatedAt, inputs, id, ...mathFields, warnings[], schema_version }

endpoints.description: Alias for GET /api/agent/freshness.json — identical handler and response shape.

Agent-readable data-freshness + confidence report wrapping groupFreshness/staleness tiers, confidenceFor/aggregate and upstream cache state. Filters: ?hardware=, ?model=, ?quant=, ?context_band=, ?max_age=, ?groupBy=hardware|model|hardwareModel, ?snapshot=. Alias: /api/agent/confidence.json.

Agent-friendly loader for the built-in workload scenario presets. No ?id= returns the directory of every valid scenario; ?id=<preset> returns token counts plus derived totalTokens/prefillShare and next-hop pointers to /api/compute. Unknown ids return 400 listing valid ids.
endpoints.returns: { description, endpoint, generatedAt, scenarios[] } or per-scenario { id, label, promptTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, prefillShare, nextSteps{} }

endpoints.description: Aggregated median + IQR speeds per hardware×model group (outlier-resistant). ?groupBy=hardware|model|quant. Cursor-paginated; for the raw run dump (no pagination) see /api/runs.

Ranked answers: ?by=decode|prefill|cost|walltime (default decode). e.g. ?by=decode&maxParamsB=8&quant=q4_k_m → top rigs for ≤8B models at Q4_K_M; ?model=<family> for that model; ?fitCheck=true&contextLength=N adds VRAM-fit. Results carry median tok/s, VRAM fit, pricing and power. For the raw run dump (no pagination) see /api/runs.
Replay a previously computed result by its stable deterministic ID (calc_<sha256-12> minted by /api/compute and /api/best).

Run inference math. ?model=singleTurn|speculative|batched|agentic|kvCache|flagged|cost plus parameters. No model param returns a self-describing capability list. POST {"batch": [up to 50 parameter sets]} returns per-index results with per-item ok/error status.

Run inference math. ?model=singleTurn|speculative|batched|agentic|kvCache|flagged|cost plus parameters. No model param returns a self-describing capability list. POST {"batch": [up to 50 parameter sets]} returns per-index results with per-item ok/error status.

Compare two measured runs side by side (?runA=<id>&runB=<id>), or diff two /api/best-style constraint sets in what-if mode (?mode=whatif&a=<constraints>&b=<constraints>). What-if sets are filters over the benchmark pool — they cannot reference a single stored run id.
One-click full-dataset export at ?format=csv|json with an accompanying data dictionary.
Uptime/status probe backing the status page: service liveness plus dataset freshness signals.

Community-measured single-stream benchmark runs with normalized model families. GET: no params = hardware summary; ?hardware=&model=&quant=&limit=N filters (cursor-paginated via next_cursor). POST: submit a new run for community benchmarking (queued, unit-audited at ingest). For the entire dataset in one call without pagination, use /api/runs.

Community-measured single-stream benchmark runs with normalized model families. GET: no params = hardware summary; ?hardware=&model=&quant=&limit=N filters (cursor-paginated via next_cursor). POST: submit a new run for community benchmarking (queued, unit-audited at ingest). For the entire dataset in one call without pagination, use /api/runs.
Model Context Protocol server endpoint. POST JSON-RPC 2.0 tool calls (initialize, tools/list, tools/call); GET returns server metadata.
Model Context Protocol server endpoint. POST JSON-RPC 2.0 tool calls (initialize, tools/list, tools/call); GET returns server metadata.
Renders a 1200x630 PNG Open Graph chart card from URL params (preset, prefill, decode, scenario, prompt). Binary image/png response; errors use problem+json.
Parses plain-language constraints into the canonical constraint struct with an explicit ambiguities array and a ready-made /api/sizing query string.
Built-in hardware speed presets (RTX 4090, dual RTX 3090, M3 Ultra, Groq LPU, H100, RPi5) and workload scenarios (RAG, code generation). Feed these into /api/compute.

One-shot machine-readable dump of the FULL run index (comparable AND batched/non-comparable runs). ?format=json|csv; ?comparable=all|true|false. JSON envelope carries schemaVersion, generatedAt, rowCount, totalRunCount and a structured dataDictionary; CSV is RFC 4180 with a #-comment preamble.

One-call hardware sizing recommendation: pass a workload spec (?model=<family>&contextLength=&concurrency=&maxTtftSeconds=&maxTpotMs=&maxVramGb=) and get ranked rigs with required-VRAM math, expected TTFT/TPOT from benchmark medians, sample confidence, and meetsSlo flags.
Versioned dataset snapshot IDs. All data endpoints accept ?snapshot=<id> (and return a snapshot object) for reproducible, citable results.
Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec — derive all endpoints from this.
Machine-readable version report: service name, app version (package.json), wire schemaVersion, generatedAt timestamp and links to /api/spec, CHANGELOG-API.md and CHANGELOG.json.
Combined model weights + KV-cache + context VRAM estimate from just {hfId, context, quant}.
Watch-feed subscriptions. GET: list combos. POST: subscribe to a hardware+model combo (returns a one-time secret). DELETE ?id=&secret=: unsubscribe.
